ui.chat.sidebar.agents.list_join.role: joiner for the agent-name list inside the built-in installation offer
ui.chat.sidebar.agents.list_join.tone: terse, neutral inline enumeration; preserve names verbatim, no sentence punctuation
ui.chat.sidebar.agents.list_join.length: Two placeholders plus separators: four characters for pair/final ( và ), two for middle (, ). Names determine width; allow wrapping without truncation.
ui.chat.sidebar.agents.list_join.note: Vietnamese joins a pair and the final item with và, without a preceding comma; intermediate items use a comma followed by a space. Keep agent names and product names verbatim.

placeholders.position: pair for two names, middle for non-final joins, end (the other arm) for the final join in lists of three or more
placeholders.head: first name or the already joined preceding names; preserve verbatim
